privateEvents.grid.linkRowLabel: Take orders by private link and QR code
privateEvents.grid.columnTitle: The built-in “Private” type. It cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.
privateEvents.form.help: Shows in your schedule as “Private event” with only the date and time — never the address, the map or Village Foodie.
privateEvents.form.linkPromise: Guests order by a private link and QR code — you will get them after saving.
privateEvents.form.nameHelp: Guests see this at the top of the ordering page.
privateEvents.form.previewNote: How it shows in your schedule — no venue, town or postcode.
privateEvents.form.needsTimes: Add a start and end time — they are needed for a private event that takes orders by link.
privateEvents.link.title: Private link and QR code
privateEvents.link.label: Private link
privateEvents.link.newLinkConfirm: Make a new link? The current link stops working immediately, and the QR codes you have already printed stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link has got somewhere it shouldn’t. The current link stops working immediately, and printed QR codes stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkFailed: A new link could not be made.
privateEvents.link.offNotice: Ordering by private link is switched off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event still shows in your schedule as “Private event”.
privateEvents.cards.blurb: Order and pay on your phone. We will call you by name when the order is ready.
privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events don’t get their own post — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
privateEvents.confirmToPrivate: This hides the address and removes the event from the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
privateEvents.confirmFromPrivate: This makes the event public: its address and the map pin will show, and the private link will stop working.
